answer: Peers cross-check attestations against a rotating challenge sonnet of randomized tasks, while an ocean of historical reputation data flags clones whose fable of origin never verifies. Each agent must stake a unique hardware attestation bound to a costly bonded deposit; forging identities requires provisioning real devices and locking capital per sybil, making mass fakery economically ruinous. The attacker's cost scales linearly with each fake identity, collapsing the profit margin. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
